description:
About the Scholarship

JANUS is the Erasmus Mundus master in security and defence coordinated from Université Jean Moulin Lyon 3, with mandatory mobility between Lyon and Beirut Saint-Joseph and options in Granada, Bucharest and Essex. The first cohort's applications closed on 6 March 2026, and the 2027-2029 round is expected to follow the same early-March pattern.

OpportunityJANUS – Erasmus Mundus Master in Security and Defence
HostJANUS Consortium (Université Jean Moulin Lyon 3)
LocationLyon (multi-country mobility), France
Study LevelMaster's
FundingFully Funded
Stipend€1,400/month for 24 months (EMJM scholarship)
Application Deadline6 March 2027
ApplyOfficial application page ↗

JANUS is the Erasmus Mundus master in security and defence coordinated from Université Jean Moulin Lyon 3, with mandatory mobility between Lyon and Beirut Saint-Joseph and options in Granada, Bucharest and Essex. The first cohort's applications closed on 6 March 2026, and the 2027-2029 round is expected to follow the same early-March pattern.

Programme Highlights

  • Distinctive security-and-defence curriculum with Lyon-Beirut core mobility
  • Specialisations in cybersecurity, criminology and high-intensity warfare
  • Professional exposure through site visits (Interpol, NATO) and internships
  • Erasmus Mundus scholarships covering fees plus living allowance

Who Should Apply

Backgrounds in law, political science, international relations, economics, history or security/defence studies are welcomed; French is not a prerequisite since the programme runs in English with language support.

Funding and Costs

Erasmus Mundus scholarships cover tuition and provide a monthly allowance for travel and living costs.

Deadline and How to Apply

Watch the JANUS how-to-apply page for the 2027-2029 call and submit before the early-March cut-off. Key deadline information: 6 March 2027 (23:59 Paris time, expected — the first round closed 6 March 2026).

Official Link

  • Official application page (verified link)

About JANUS Consortium (Université Jean Moulin Lyon 3)

The JANUS consortium is coordinated by Université Jean Moulin Lyon 3 and delivers the Erasmus Mundus Joint Master in Security and Defence with partners in Lebanon, Spain, Romania and the UK.

Official website: https://master-janus-security-defense.eu

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 6 March 2027 - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.
